messages:
nolan: Quick check 1 ProcuraQ sent a draft commercial with seat + token + embeddings. Looks messy, want a sanity check before reply.

maya: Flagged the "active model calls" metric in the quote. Could double-count streaming.

amanda: Asked vendor for a worked example (our baseline: 500k tokens/mo, 120k vectors, 10GB storage). They sent a sample PDF with contradictory lines for embedding pricing.

jess: We use 1536-d vectors. Need vendor to confirm whether price is per-vector regardless of dim or if they normalize to 1k vectors. Also confirm if embedding generation is billed separately from storage/serving.

amanda: Vendor replied: "vectors billed per 1k vectors; dims irrelevant. Storage $0.05/GB/mo. Egress may apply for Private deployments based on topology. Pilot requires MSA without SLA."

nolan: Good. Amanda please upload their sample invoice and ask for a line-item calc for our baseline. Maya, check budget impact; base fee is material. Jess, draft data residency and hosting questions.

procurement-bot: Task created: PR-2026-137 ProcuraQ vendor eval. Approvers: maya, nolan, legal, eng-lead. Link: https://tools.redwood/approvals/PR-2026-137

amanda: Uploaded invoice workbook to procurement drive (link pasted). Vendor's workbook models our baseline ~ $9.6k/mo (includes base + tokens + embeddings + storage).

nolan: Thanks. We'll decide at a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Drop any MSA redlines or sample invoices here.
